title: Claude can now plug directly into Photoshop, Blender, and Ableton

title: Google and Pentagon reportedly agree on deal for ‘any lawful’ use of AI
raw_excerpt: Google has signed a classified deal that allows the US Department of Defense to use its AI models for "any lawful government purpose," The Information reports . The agreement was reported less than a day after Google employees demanded CEO Sundar Pichai block the Pentagon from using its AI amid concerns that it would be used in "inhumane or extremely harmful ways." If the agreement is confirmed, it would place Google alongside OpenAI and xAI, which have also made classified AI deals with the US government. summary: 据 The Information 报道，谷歌与美国国防部签署机密 AI 协议，允许五角大楼将谷歌 AI 用于“任何合法政府目的”，条款宽松程度超过 OpenAI 此前协议。该消息发布前一天，谷歌员工曾要求 CEO 阻止军方使用其 AI。此举引发对 AI 军事化应用的广泛争议。

title: Introducing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni: Long-Context Multimodal Intelligence for Documents, Audio and Video Agents
summary: NVIDIA 发布 Nemotron 3 Nano Omni 多模态模型，支持长上下文文档、音频和视频理解。该模型专为 Agent 场景设计，可在边缘设备上运行，为文档分析、音视频处理等任务提供高效的多模态智能。这是 NVIDIA 在端侧多模态 AI 领域的重要布局。

title: OpenAI Misses Key Revenue, User Targets in High-Stakes Sprint Toward IPO
raw_excerpt: OpenAI missed its own targets for new users and revenue, raising concern among company leaders about whether it will be able to support its massive spending on data centers. The company's Chief Financial Officer has said that she is worried that OpenAI may not be able to pay for future computing contracts if revenue doesn't grow fast enough. Board directors have been questioning CEO Sam Altman's efforts to secure even more computing power despite the business slowdown. Company executives are now seeking to control costs and instill more discipline in the business.
summary: 据 WSJ 报道，OpenAI 未达成新用户和营收目标，引发领导层对能否支撑数据中心巨额支出的担忧。CFO 担心收入增长不足以支付未来计算合同，董事会质疑 CEO Altman 在业务放缓下仍追求更多算力的做法。公司正寻求控制成本、加强纪律。

title: China Blocks Meta Manus Acquisition
raw_excerpt: China halted Meta's $2B acquisition of agentic AI startup Manus, ordering the deal unwound amid regulatory scrutiny, complicating Meta's push into AI agents and cross-border expansion.
summary: 中国叫停 Meta 对 AI Agent 初创公司 Manus 的 20 亿美元收购，要求撤销交易。此前中国已进行数月审查。此举打击了 Meta 的 AI Agent 扩张计划，也凸显了跨境 AI 并购面临的地缘政治阻力。

title: Former Google DeepMind researcher's AI startup raises record $1.1 billion seed funding to pursue superintelligence
raw_excerpt: David Silver is a UCL professor and the former lead of DeepMind's reinforcement learning team.
summary: 前 Google DeepMind 强化学习负责人 David Silver 创立的 AI 公司 Ineffable Intelligence 以 11 亿美元种子轮融资创纪录，投资方包括 Nvidia 和 Google。公司目标直指超级智能，这是 AI 领域迄今为止最大规模的种子轮融资。

title: DeepSeek cuts V4-Pro prices by 75%
raw_excerpt: DeepSeek is offering a 75% discount on its V4-Pro model pricing and reducing input cache hits by 90%, challenging US AI giants in a tense geopolitical backdrop.
summary: DeepSeek 将 V4-Pro 模型价格下调 75%，并将输入缓存命中成本降低 90%。在紧张的地缘政治背景下，这一激进定价策略直接挑战美国 AI 巨头，可能引发新一轮价格战。

title: GPU Spot Prices Surge 114% in Six Weeks
raw_excerpt: NVIDIA's B200 GPU's rental price soared 114% to $4.95 per hour due to demand from AI models like GPT-5.5.
summary: NVIDIA B200 GPU 租赁价格六周内飙升 114% 至每小时 4.95 美元，原因是 GPT-5.5 等新模型需求激增。GPU 现货市场的剧烈波动反映了 AI 算力供需失衡的持续加剧。

title: OpenAI models coming to Amazon Bedrock: Interview with OpenAI and AWS CEOs
summary: OpenAI 与 AWS 达成合作，OpenAI 模型将通过 Amazon Bedrock 提供服务。两家公司 CEO 接受 Stratechery 专访，讨论 Bedrock 托管 Agent 等合作细节。此举标志着 OpenAI 从独家 Azure 转向多云策略，重塑 AI 云服务格局。
